name: Persian Wikipedia official articles dump (2026-10-01)
underlying_text: Official Wikimedia current-revisions dump; primary modern factual Persian prose.
attribution_required: yes (link to article/history or contributor list)
rights_verification: official Wikimedia ToU and dump index
rationale: Use the dated 20261001 pages-articles file, not the mutable 'latest' symlink. CC BY-SA share-alike may affect redistributed derived corpus; this is not legal advice.

name: Persian Wikibooks official articles dump (2026-11-01)
underlying_text: Free textbooks/how-to prose; small but genuinely educational modern Persian.
rights_verification: official Wikimedia ToU and dump index
rationale: Small source; useful as explanatory/educational register, not as a volume filler.

name: Persian Wikisource official articles dump (2026-11-01)
underlying_text: Public-domain or freely licensed source texts; literary/historical prose and verse.
license_content: per-page: public domain or compatible free license; page contributions CC BY-SA 4.0
commercial_use: yes for PD/free pages with conditions
rights_verification: official Wikisource copyright policy and dump index
rationale: Extractor accepts ONLY exact verified template names from configs/source_policy.json. NC/ND/incompatible, generic Copyright/مجوز/پروانه, unknown licence-like templates and unlabeled pages are rejected with an exact reason; the matched template is stored in metadata. No corpus-size weakening. Classical register, not modern prose.

name: Persian Wikinews official articles dump (2026-11-01)
underlying_text: Collaboratively written news-style Persian prose; small, modern register.
rationale: Wikinews is licensed CC BY 2.5, NOT CC BY-SA 4.0; keep its license tag distinct in the manifest.

name: Mozilla Common Voice Persian sentence files (rights review pending)
underlying_text: Natural short Persian sentences contributed to / collected for Common Voice; text only, no audio.
license_content: uncertain per-file sentence rights; README says majority CC0
rights_verification: README states majority CC0; exact pinned fa files lack per-line provenance
rationale: QUARANTINE pending file-level sentence origin/CC0 audit; no audio or speaker metadata.

name: Tatoeba Persian detailed sentences (CC BY 2.0 FR, author attribution)
underlying_text: Verified Persian-only Tatoeba weekly detailed export; contributor names retained only in provenance metadata.
license_compilation: CC BY 2.0 FR weekly sentence export
license_content: CC BY 2.0 FR by default; some CC0; attribution retained for every row
attribution_required: yes: contributor username and CC BY 2.0 FR notice in metadata
commercial_use: yes with author attribution and licence conditions
redistribution: yes with author attribution and licence notice
privacy_risk: low (public contributor pseudonyms in provenance metadata only)
rights_verification: official Tatoeba downloads/terms, per_language/pes index and detailed-field documentation
rationale: Official per_language/pes index lists pes_sentences_detailed.tsv.bz2, 695,149 bytes, dated 2026-10-31. The detailed fields are id, lang, text, username, date_added, date_last_modified (tab-separated MySQL OUTFILE). Language code is ISO 639-3 `pes`, NOT `fas`. Usernames, sentence IDs, dates, source filename and Tatoeba CC BY 2.0 FR attribution stay in metadata; training text is only the Persian sentence. The export is mutable weekly: download_manifest.json records the observed snapshot date, actual SHA-256 and size; ordinary resume does not refresh a verified snapshot and --force is the explicit refresh. A real all-language fallback parses sentences_detailed.csv inside sentences_detailed.tar.bz2; it does NOT search for imaginary per-language TSV members. Some sentences may be CC0, but the detailed export does not mark them, so attribution is conservatively retained for every row.

name: Ganjoor classical works, public-domain-only subset
underlying_text: Classical Persian poetry/prose from ganjoor-tex; only pre-modern poet directories in the allowlist.
license_content: underlying classical works are public domain; transcription/typesetting may be GPL-3.0
attribution_required: yes (Ganjoor + GPL notice for redistributed data files)
share_alike: GPL-3.0 may apply to redistributed data files
commercial_use: yes for PD works; GPL obligations for data files
rights_verification: GitHub GPL-3.0 license file + classical author list
rationale: Only the 12 classical directories present at the pinned commit are allowed. A modern poet's work must NOT be added until its rights are verified. One source file per document; no cross-file stitching.

name: Chronological Persian Poetry Dataset (CC BY-SA 4.0)
underlying_text: Ganjoor-derived poems; CC BY-SA compilation, underlying work rights unresolved.
copyright_holder: poets / dataset compiler; per-work rights unresolved
rights_verification: CC BY-SA compilation only; upstream Ganjoor database; no per-work rights evidence
rationale: QUARANTINE until per-work underlying rights established. Preserve poet, century and CC BY-SA compilation attribution.

name: V1 Wikipedia 2021 cleaned CSV mirror (optional recovery source)
underlying_text: The 865k-article cleaned CSV used by V1; recoverable from split 7z parts in a GitHub mirror.
rights_verification: Wikimedia ToU; V1 sources.json; mirror README
rationale: OPTIONAL and disabled by default: download_sources.py needs --include-optional, and py7zr must be installed explicitly with requirements-7z.txt. Prefer the official 2026 dump for modern Persian. This source is included to audit V1's claim that 538M filtered characters were recoverable.

name: ParsiNLU QA / multiple-choice / entailment annotations
underlying_text: Explicitly CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 Persian task annotations. Research-only, separate output.
redistribution: yes only under NC-SA and research conditions
rationale: Excludes reading-comprehension passages taken from publisher-copyright news. Do not include synthetic task markers in the main corpus; keep natural text fields only.

name: V1 Persian news corpus (5 agencies)
underlying_text: Publisher-copyright news articles; no license declared.
rationale: Quarantine: public download does not grant rights to underlying articles. Do not train on it.

name: V1 pn-summary news articles
underlying_text: MIT repository but publisher-copyright news text; V1 quality gate also rejected it.
rights_verification: MIT does not cover article text
rationale: Quarantine: underlying rights unverified and punctuation was stripped upstream.

name: V1 PeQa Twitter-derived dialogue
underlying_text: 14M public tweets/replies; MIT repository does not license the tweets.
rationale: Quarantine: identifiable personal social-media content and unverified underlying rights.

name: SLPL/naab cleaned Persian web corpus
underlying_text: 130 GB / ~250M paragraphs / ~15B words; mixed Common Crawl, news, Telegram, private company corpus, blogs.
license_content: underlying web/Telegram/private texts; not licensed by the compilation
rights_verification: card explicitly takes no responsibility for personal information
rationale: QUARANTINE. Do not download the full 137 GB. MIT metadata and 'mit?' card do not license crawled pages, Telegram messages, or formerly private data.

name: shekar-ai/Shiraz Persian web corpus
underlying_text: 6.25M rows / 5.97 GB across 14 sites; contains BBC Persian, Civilica, blogs, generated retrieval queries.
license_content: underlying web content remains subject to original authors' rights and site terms
rights_verification: dataset card explicitly disclaims granting underlying content rights
rationale: QUARANTINE. ODC-BY covers selection/annotations only; BBC and Civilica content has separate rights. Synthetic query columns must never enter pretraining.

name: Targoman Large Persian Corpus (TLPC)
underlying_text: 98.6 GB / 75M documents / 41B claimed tokens scraped from 800+ sites; CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 compilation.
license_content: scraped third-party web pages plus reader comments with commenter names/dates
rationale: QUARANTINE by default, despite a clear NC license: documented personal data (names/dates in comments) and uncertain third-party rights. Conditional PROFILE B only after documented PII scrubbing and review.

name: MirasText news corpus
underlying_text: 2.8M articles / 1.4B words from 250+ news sites; password-controlled full release.
rights_verification: MIT repo does not license articles; access control present
rationale: QUARANTINE. Do not request or bypass the archive password from this pipeline.

name: persiannlp/persian-raw-text 80 GB mixture
underlying_text: 65 GB Common Crawl + MirasText + W2C + Wikipedia + Leipzig + VOA + poems + TEP; no license.
rationale: QUARANTINE. No deduplication upstream, mixed rights, Common Crawl terms push copyright responsibility to the user.

underlying_text: Common-Crawl-derived Persian subsets; dataset licenses do not grant rights to crawled pages.

rationale: EXCLUDE from pretraining; not natural continuous Persian prose.

underlying_text: 7.9M-word VOA corpus; possible US-government public-domain status not authoritatively verified here.
